items.text: Among students in grades 8 to 12 in the 2025 school health survey, is the number of licensed tobacco retailers within 800 metres of their school (none, 1 to 4, 5 or more) associated with current smoking, after adjustment for school socioeconomic status, neighbourhood deprivation, remoteness, age and sex?
items.population: Students in grades 8 to 12 in 186 surveyed schools
items.intervention: Five or more licensed retailers within 800 metres (road network)
items.outcome: Current smoking (any in the past 30 days)
items.setting: State secondary schools, capital and regional towns

items.text: Is the same exposure associated with current vaping?
items.outcome: Current vaping (any in the past 30 days)

finer: Feasible with existing data and one analyst if access is granted; interesting to councils and the minister; novel for the licensing era; ethical with de-identified data; relevant to a live policy decision.
summary: Two PECO questions for smoking and vaping.
